Chapter 651: Chapter 3: Twenty Years (5000 words, please subscribe)_2

“Alright.” Lin Yuan nodded, “Then I’ll be going first.”

As Lin Yuan finished speaking, a figure suddenly appeared beside him.

He too had come to pay homage to the Xia Qin Supreme Being.

“Nalan, the deputy tower master?” Lin Yuan’s expression was stunned as he recognized the other person.

Nalan, the deputy tower master, was positioned under the Xia Qin Supreme Being at the Xia You Evolution Tower.

Previously, when handling the affairs of the Insect Race on the Battlefields of Different Races, it was Nalan who acted against the Heiyuan Clan on behalf of human civilization.

...

With his own power, Nalan suppressed several Tenth-Rank elders of the Heiyuan Clan who hid in the Heiyuan Secret Realm and didn’t dare to come out until he had demolished the entire fringe regions of the Heiyuan Clan.

Additionally, when the Xia Qin Supreme Being bestowed the Soul-Settling Pearl, it was Nalan who crossed the vast distances to personally deliver it to Lin Yuan’s hands.

By now, Lin Yuan also had a deep understanding of Nalan’s strength — a Grade A of Tenth Rank and a terrifying existence within Grade A.

Out of the nine Evolution Towers of human civilization, all the deputy tower masters are Tenth Rank. And why not Eleventh Rank?

Those at the Eleventh Rank were each preparing to challenge the ultimate, never readily giving up, even with slim hopes.

The role of deputy tower master in the Evolution Towers mostly involved dealing with trivial matters outside the path of evolution — matters that Supreme Beings couldn’t bother with and Eleventh-Rank Evolvers had no time for.

Therefore, those serving as deputy tower masters were generally Tenth-Rank Evolvers.

Of course, to highlight the status of the deputy tower masters, only those who could at least begin at a Grade A Tenth Rank were eligible, and Nalan was one of the outstanding leaders among them.

“Galaxy Master.” Nalan, the deputy tower master, nodded slightly; he naturally recognized Lin Yuan too.

Nowadays, the name of Galaxy Master was as bright as the sun within human civilization, bolstered by various halos. It was hard not to notice him.

However, Nalan felt no different emotion for the situation, as the Galaxy Master indeed deserved this recognition. At least, Nalan himself hadn’t reached the heights of Galaxy Master when he was at the Ninth Rank.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan exited from the Supreme Being’s personal world.

“Supreme Being.” Nalan, the deputy tower master, looked up, gazing at the high throne where Xia Qin Supreme Being sat.

“Supreme Being seems in good spirits?” Nalan was curious; he rarely saw Xia Qin Supreme Being show emotional fluctuations.

Reaching the level of Supreme Being with eternal existence, hardly anything could pique their interest anymore.

“I have seen the future of human civilization.” Xia Qin Supreme Being said with a smile. Lin Yuan had such insight into the Rule of Time at the Ninth Rank.

Moreover, with the establishment of the Martial Arts Evolution System… in Xia Qin’s view, Lin Yuan had much stronger hopes of reaching the ultimate than those other Eleventh-Rank Evolvers of human civilization.

“The future of human civilization?” Nalan, the deputy tower master was somewhat puzzled. Only the lofty Supreme Beings seemed fit to bear that phrase.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

“The guidance from the Supreme Being indeed allowed me to take a shortcut.” A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

Without that explanation from Xia Qin Supreme Being, even if he could have grasped the Three You Time Index, it would have taken him several months or even a year or two.

“But such guidance was effective because it was built on the foundation of my own accumulation.” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Before consulting the Supreme Being, Lin Yuan had been trapped by this bottleneck for a while and had tried various approaches.

It was because of this that, with just a slight explanation from Xia Qin Supreme Being, Lin Yuan was able to immediately integrate and understand.

If he hadn’t tried various methods before and sought to consult the Supreme Being immediately upon encountering a bottleneck, he probably wouldn’t have achieved such an effect.

“Xia Qin Supreme Being told me to figure out all the time models and then visit him again…” Lin Yuan remembered the advice Xia Qin Supreme Being gave before he left.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Chun Bo, Jia Li, Hongpi, and several other administrators paid their respects to Lin Yuan.

Normally, matters of the Milky Way Main Star, and even those of the Milky Way Star Region, were decided after discussions among them, and the results were then unanimously reported to Lin Yuan.

They would only seek an audience with Lin Yuan if there were situations they couldn’t decide on or weren’t qualified to handle.

“Star Lord.” Chun Bo, Jia Li, and the others were very respectful, looking at the young man sitting cross-legged on the ground. Just looking at him, they felt their spirits tremble, with no thoughts of resistance arising.

It was as if ordinary citizens or First-Rank Evolvers, faced with the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun larger than a planet, were pressured by the essence of life, lacking any hostile thoughts.

“The Star Lord is already concealing his aura as much as possible, but we still feel a great pressure. How strong is the Star Lord exactly?” The main star administrators couldn’t help but wonder.

“Now, amongst my human civilization, the Star Lord’s reputation even surpasses many Tenth-Rank Evolvers. The events at the Xuanhuang Secret Realm have caused many Different Species to both hate and fear the Star Lord.”

As Eighth-Rank Evolvers, the few present were well-informed and had access to the upper echelons of human civilization, having long heard about the recent events at the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

“The current strength of the Star Lord probably far exceeds that of the old master by now,” Hongpi and the two Eighth-Rank aliens from Different Species silently marveled, “The old master was worried that the Star Lord, newly advanced to the Eighth Rank, might be bullied upon taking charge of the star domain. How much time has passed since then, and who would dare to bully the Star Lord now?”

Hongpi and the others were deeply moved, as they could be considered Lin Yuan’s inner circle of confidants, from the time of Chikun Star Lord to now the Galaxy Master.

As members of Different Species, Hongpi and the others were destined not to have much development within human civilization; their only reliance was the Galaxy Master.
